about_the_game:
Cosmic Star Lounge – A Social VR Playground Across the Stars

Step into Cosmic Star Lounge, a thrilling 2-4 player multiplayer VR experience that transports you and your friends to a cosmic hub, a stylish space lounge that serves as a gateway to vast, arcade-inspired worlds. In this ever-expanding universe, you’ll jump between action-packed mini-games, each offering a unique challenge that tests your skills, strategy, and teamwork.

With a blend of competitive and cooperative gameplay, Cosmic Star Lounge Demo lets you: 

   

  • Mode: 1vs1 Duel

  • In this high-stakes wizard duel, two players take on the roles of powerful magicians, each standing on a floating platform suspended within the eye of a massive storm. Players can cast a variety of spells, including fireballs, reflective shields, and a summonable crystal golem that marches toward the enemy mage. Timing, reflexes, and strategic spell casting determine the victor, making this duel a test of both offense and defense.

  • Mode: 1-4 Player Arcade

  • Players enter a peaceful Japanese dojo and garden, transformed into an archery shooting gallery. Equipped with bows, players aim to hit a variety of targets, including special bonus targets, that appear across the range. The game combines precision, speed, and accuracy as players compete to achieve the highest score. The calm aesthetics of the dojo add to the immersive experience, making each round both challenging and serene.

    The full Cosmic Star Lounge will also let you experience: 

  • Mode: 1vs1 or 2vs2 Team Battle

  • Castle Defense combines both MOBA and Tower Defense game genres, in an intense, team-based battle. Players face off in a fantasy landscape, with one team defending a light castle and the other a dark one, separated by a ravine. Each team occupies a gate tower equipped with a magic ballista and the ability to hurl bombs to defend against any threats nearing their gate. Additionally, players can deploy three types of minions (siege, ranged, melee) to walk across the single bridge to attack the enemy’s gate. The goal is to breach the opposing team’s gate first, combining strategy, accuracy, and teamwork to achieve victory.

  • Mode: 1-4 Player Arcade

  • Players can test their golfing skills across nine courses in scenic landscapes: five in the breathtaking Swiss Alps and four in the rolling hills of the Italian Toscana. The game features fun, VR-adapted golfing mechanics, bringing players a mixture of realistic physics and arcade-style gameplay. The immersive surroundings enhance each shot, creating an atmosphere as relaxing as it is competitive.

     

  • Mode: 1vs1 or 2vs2 Team Game

  • Players step into the Hovercraft Arena Grand Final, where the Vipers and Jackals clash in a high-stakes battle for supremacy—This fast-paced game is a VR take on car soccer, where players control hovercrafts to guide a giant ball across a soccer-like arena, attempting to score in the opponent’s goal. The mechanics focus on speed, maneuverability, and precision, allowing players to develop teamwork and scoring strategies. The arena is designed to amplify the hovercraft’s movements, creating thrilling, action-packed gameplay for both team and solo players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index Controllers, Meta Quest Touch Controllers and HTC VIVE Wands. Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, HTC VIVE, and Steam Index.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX™ 2080 / AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index Controllers, Meta Quest Touch Controllers and HTC VIVE Wands. Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, HTC VIVE, and Steam Index.

short_description: Cosmic Star Lounge is a thrilling, 2-4 player multiplayer VR experience. Set in an immersive, space lounge that connects to different universes, Cosmic Star Lounge invites you and your friends to dive into a collection of multiple, arcade-inspired VR games.
